mentions.name: Job application autofill Chrome extension
mentions.description: A Chrome extension that autofills job applications, dramatically speeding up the time it takes to apply to each job, even on complicated applicant tracking systems (ATSs).
mentions.problem: Applying to jobs manually is time-consuming, especially on complicated applicant tracking systems (ATSs).
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a Chrome extension that will help with autofilling job applications. It has dramatically sped up the time it takes to apply to each job even on complicated ATS's.
